report.root_cause: The robot lacks the necessary boot traction to overcome gravity and push uphill on the 35-degree slope, resulting in a failure to make positive ascent progress.
evidence: ascent remains near 0 or negative throughout the episode (e.g., -0.007m at step 495)
uphill_speed is consistently near zero or negative despite active movement
boot_traction_enabled is false in the configuration
report.expected_after_fix: The robot will be able to generate sufficient forward force to increase ascent_m and successfully climb the slope.
